summary: ØRSTED A/S (LEI W9NG6WMZIYEU8VEDOG48, DK CVR 36213728) is an identifier-confirmed Danish-registered entity with a large multinational subsidiary structure spanning Denmark, the United Kingdom, the United States, and Taiwan, as evidenced by more than twenty GLEIF Level 2 accounting-consolidation child relationships. Ownership is partially disclosed: the Government of Denmark (via the Ministry of Finance, indicatively reported at 50.1% per Wikidata sourced from a 2019 annual report) is the principal shareholder, with Andel AMBA/Andel Energy (indicatively 7.28%) and Equinor ASA also holding stakes per OpenSanctions and Wikidata; Goldman Sachs (indicatively 13.0%) and Capital Group Companies (indicatively 6.0%) are recorded on Wikidata from a 2016 source and may no longer be current. No accounting-consolidation parent is reported to GLEIF, reflecting a permitted NON_CONSOLIDATING reporting exception at both direct and ultimate parent level, as the controlling legal entities are not subject to preparing consolidated financial statements. One structural risk signal was identified: the ownership chain has three or more corporate layers (medium confidence, per GLEIF data), meeting the AMLA complexity threshold; additionally, ten named officers and directors carry possible PEP name-matches via OpenAleph against the Denmark, Faroe Islands and Greenland PEPs dataset (medium confidence each), but in every case the match is by name only with no corroborating birth date or nationality, so none constitutes a confirmed PEP identification. Material limitations include: ownership percentages from Wikidata are indicative only and sourced from documents dated 2016 and 2019; the Danish state shareholding is a structural indicator of possible state control (presence-only, sourced from Wikidata and OpenSanctions) and its absence is not evidenced to the contrary; and OpenSanctions data is licensed CC-BY-NC-4.0, restricting commercial re-use.

claims.text: ØRSTED A/S is an identifier-confirmed Danish-registered entity with LEI W9NG6WMZIYEU8VEDOG48 and DK CVR 36213728.
ØRSTED A/S has a large multinational subsidiary structure, with GLEIF Level 2 accounting-consolidation child relationships recorded across Denmark, the United Kingdom, the United States, and Taiwan.
The Government of Denmark holds a shareholding in Ørsted, per OpenSanctions.
The Ministry of Finance of Denmark is indicatively reported to hold 50.1% of Ørsted, per Wikidata sourced from a 2019 annual report; this figure is indicative only and not authoritative.
Andel AMBA holds a shareholding in Ørsted per OpenSanctions; Andel Energy is indicatively reported to hold 7.28% per Wikidata sourced from a 2019 annual report.
Equinor ASA holds a shareholding in Ørsted per OpenSanctions.
Goldman Sachs is indicatively reported to hold 13.0% of Ørsted per Wikidata, sourced from a 2016 annual report; this figure is indicative only and may no longer be current.
Capital Group Companies is indicatively reported to hold 6.0% of Ørsted per Wikidata, sourced from a 2016 annual report; this figure is indicative only and may no longer be current.

No accounting-consolidation parent is reported to GLEIF; this reflects a permitted NON_CONSOLIDATING reporting exception at both direct and ultimate parent level, as the controlling legal entities are not subject to preparing consolidated financial statements.
The Danish state shareholding is a structural indicator of possible state control (presence-only, sourced from Wikidata and OpenSanctions); its absence is not evidenced to the contrary.
A structural risk signal was identified: the ownership chain has three or more corporate layers, meeting the AMLA complexity threshold (medium confidence, per GLEIF data).

Ten named officers and directors — Andrew Richard Dingley Brown (næstformand from 2024-03-05), Karl Johnny Hersvik (bestyrelsesmedlem from 2026-04-09), Julia Elizabeth King (bestyrelsesmedlem from 2021-03-01), Julian David Waldron (bestyrelsesmedlem from 2025-04-03), Trond Ødegård Westlie (direktør from 2024-04-01), Rasmus Errboe (adm. dir. from 2025-02-01), Benny Gøbel (bestyrelsesmedlem from 2011-04-12), and Ruchit Majmudar (bestyrelsesmedlem from 2026-04-09) — carry possible PEP name-matches via OpenAleph against the Denmark, Faroe Islands and Greenland PEPs dataset (medium confidence each), but in every case the match is by name only with no corroborating birth date or nationality, so none constitutes a confirmed PEP identification.
Lene Skole-Sørensen holds the position of formand (chair) from 2024-03-05, per OpenCorporates.
Ownership percentages from Wikidata are indicative only, sourced from documents dated 2016 and 2019, and may not reflect the current ownership structure.
OpenSanctions data is licensed CC-BY-NC-4.0, restricting commercial re-use of that data.

limitations: Ownership percentages are sourced from Wikidata (a crowd-sourced knowledge base) and reference documents dated 2016 and 2019; they are indicative only and may not reflect the current ownership structure.
The Danish state shareholding indicator is presence-only (sourced from Wikidata and OpenSanctions); absence of state control is not evidenced.

No accounting-consolidation parent is disclosed to GLEIF under a permitted NON_CONSOLIDATING exception; GLEIF Level 2 records accounting consolidation, not beneficial ownership, so ultimate beneficial ownership is not established from this source.
All ten PEP name-matches are unconfirmed (name-only, no corroborating birth date or nationality); none constitutes a positive PEP identification.
OpenSanctions data is licensed CC-BY-NC-4.0 and may not be commercially re-used without a separate licence (g1).
The CVR Denmark register was listed as a consulted source but no CVR-specific facts were returned in the packet, limiting the authoritative register-level verification of officer and ownership data.

risks.label: No parent in GLEIF (permitted reporting exception)
risks.rationale: No accounting-consolidation parent is reported to GLEIF: NON_CONSOLIDATING for the direct and ultimate parent (its controlling legal entities are not subject to preparing consolidated financial statements). Structural context, not a risk finding — these are permitted exceptions under the LEI ROC policy, and GLEIF Level 2 records accounting consolidation, not beneficial ownership.

risks.label: Outside EU/EEA
risks.rationale: Ownership chain reaches jurisdictions outside the EU/EEA: GB, TW, US-AZ, US-DE. Structural context, not a risk finding — neither the AMLA CDD RTS nor AMLR Annex III treats non-EU status as a risk factor in itself. Contributes to AMLA Article 12(1) condition (b) only where it appears on the layered ownership path.

risks.label: Complex ownership layers
risks.rationale: Ownership chain has 3 corporate layers (AMLA threshold: ≥3).
